verdicts.reason: Both lose the design: the barrel hero photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail beside an icon-sized logo, the thin divider dash is stretched into a heavy black bar, and the torn-paper texture floats on its own as a meaningless block. A at least spaces the headline, tagline and photo/logo cluster into separate columns with some breathing room. B jams the photo and logo against the black bar under the headline and pushes 'Discover the difference' against the right canvas edge, so it is slightly worse.
